name: cards
definition: 一种可被玩家收集、构筑与在对局中使用的游戏实体，具有名称、颜色标识、法术力费用与边框版本等属性。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌系列」辨析：卡牌系列是卡牌的发行集合，卡牌是系列中的单个成员。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table cards; provenance: direct source cards

name: foreign_data
definition: 记录某一卡牌在非默认语言下的名称、文本与风味文字等本地化信息的信息记录。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌」辨析：外文卡牌数据是卡牌的语言变体描述，不是卡牌本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table foreign_data; provenance: direct source foreign_data

name: legalities
definition: 记录某一卡牌在特定比赛赛制下是否被允许使用的状态信息。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌」辨析：赛制合法性是卡牌在赛制中的使用状态，不是卡牌实体本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table legalities; provenance: direct source legalities

name: rulings
definition: 记录官方针对某一卡牌规则问题所作出的解释与判定说明的信息记录。 Counterexample: 与「赛制合法性」辨析：卡牌裁定解释规则如何适用，赛制合法性说明卡牌能否在赛制中使用。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table rulings; provenance: direct source rulings

name: set_translations
definition: 记录某一卡牌系列名称在特定语言下译名的信息记录。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌系列」辨析：系列翻译是系列名称的本地化文本，不是系列本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table set_translations; provenance: direct source set_translations

name: sets
definition: 按特定发行计划发布的一组卡牌的集合，具有代码、名称、发行日期与总牌数等属性。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌」辨析：卡牌系列是卡牌的发行集合，卡牌是系列中的单个成员。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table sets; provenance: direct source sets

name: CardName
definition: The English name of a Magic card.

name: Artist
definition: The illustrator credited on a card.

name: BorderColor
definition: The border color style of a card (e.g. black, white, borderless).

name: Power
definition: The power value printed on a creature card; '*' or NULL means unknown/infinite.
scope: cards where power = '*' OR power IS NULL

name: IsPromo
definition: Flag indicating the card is a promotional printing.

name: IsStorySpotlight
definition: Flag indicating the card is part of the Story Spotlight series.

name: IsTextless
definition: Flag indicating the card has no text box.
aliases: do not have a text box

name: CardKingdomFoilId
definition: Card Kingdom foil product identifier; non-null means a foil version exists.
scope: cards where cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL

name: CardKingdomId
definition: Card Kingdom product identifier; non-null means a Card Kingdom listing exists.
scope: cards where cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

name: FrameVersion
definition: The frame style/version of the card (e.g. 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015, future).

name: Colors
definition: The color(s) of the card (e.g. 'B' for black).

name: CardText
definition: The rules text of the card.

name: SetName
definition: The English name of a card set.

name: BaseSetSize
definition: The number of cards in the base set.

name: IsForeignOnly
definition: Flag indicating the set is only available outside the United States.
aliases: only available outside the United States

name: SetTranslation
definition: The localized translation of a set name.
scope: set_translations where translation IS NOT NULL

name: Language
definition: The language of a card printing or set translation.

name: ForeignName
definition: The localized name of a card in a foreign language.

name: ForeignType
definition: The localized type line of a card in a foreign language.
scope: foreign_data where type IS NOT NULL

name: Format
definition: The name of a play format (e.g. commander, standard).

name: LegalityStatus
definition: The legality status of a card in a format (Legal, Banned, Restricted, etc.).

name: RulingCount
definition: The number of rulings associated with a card.

name: PercentageChineseSimplified
definition: Share of cards that have a Chinese Simplified printing. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Language = 'Chinese Simplified') / COUNT(CardName) * 100. Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Language = foreign_data.language
aliases: percentage of the cards available in Chinese Simplified

name: PercentageBorderless
definition: Share of cards with borderless border color. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE BorderColor = 'borderless') / COUNT(CardName) * 100. Inputs: CardName = cards.name; BorderColor = cards.borderColor

name: PercentageStorySpotlightTextless
definition: Share of Story Spotlight cards that are textless. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE IsStorySpotlight = 1 AND IsTextless = 1) / COUNT(CardName WHERE IsStorySpotlight = 1) * 100. Inputs: CardName = cards.name; IsStorySpotlight = cards.isStorySpotlight WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1; IsTextless = cards.isTextless WHERE isTextless = 1
aliases: percentage of Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text

name: PercentagePowerfulFoilsInSet
definition: Share of cards in a set that have both Card Kingdom foil and non-foil IDs. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE SetName = 'Coldsnap' AND CardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND CardKingdomId IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(CardName WHERE SetName = 'Coldsnap') * 100. Inputs: CardName = cards.name; SetName = sets.name; CardKingdomFoilId = cards.cardKingdomFoilId WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL; CardKingdomId = cards.cardKingdomId WHERE cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
aliases: percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set

name: CountUnknownPower
definition: Number of cards whose power is '*' or NULL. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Power = '*' OR Power IS NULL). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Power = cards.power WHERE power = '*' OR power IS NULL
aliases: how many cards have infinite power

name: CountUnknownPowerWithTriggeredAbility
definition: Number of unknown-power cards whose text mentions a triggered ability. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE (Power = '*' OR Power IS NULL) AND CardText LIKE '%triggered ability%'). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Power = cards.power WHERE power = '*' OR power IS NULL; CardText = cards.text WHERE text LIKE '%triggered ability%'
aliases: unknown power cards contain info about the triggered ability
count unknown power with triggered ability

name: CountItalianSetsUnder100
definition: Number of sets with an Italian translation and base set size under 100. Formula: COUNT(SetName WHERE Language = 'Italian' AND BaseSetSize < 100). Inputs: SetName = sets.name; Language = foreign_data.language; BaseSetSize = sets.baseSetSize WHERE baseSetSize < 100
aliases: sets of cards that have an Italian translation with base set

name: MaxRulingCount
definition: Maximum number of rulings associated with any single card. Formula: MAX(RulingCount). Inputs: RulingCount = rulings.uuid

name: CountLegalCommanderUnknownPower
definition: Number of unknown-power cards legal in commander format. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE (Power = '*' OR Power IS NULL) AND Format = 'commander' AND LegalityStatus = 'Legal'). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Power = cards.power WHERE power = '*' OR power IS NULL; Format = legalities.format; LegalityStatus = legalities.status WHERE status = 'Legal'
aliases: cards with unknown power legal for commander

name: CountBannedByArtist
definition: Number of banned cards illustrated by a given artist. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Artist = 'Allen Williams' AND LegalityStatus = 'Banned'). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Artist = cards.artist; LegalityStatus = legalities.status WHERE status = 'Legal'
aliases: banned cards Allen Williams worked on

name: CountForeignLanguageArtifactsBlack
definition: Number of black Artifact cards that have a foreign-language printing. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE ForeignType LIKE '%Artifact%' AND Colors = 'B' AND Language IS NOT NULL). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; ForeignType = foreign_data.type WHERE type IS NOT NULL; Colors = cards.colors; Language = foreign_data.language
aliases: Artifact cards which are black color and come with foreign l

name: CountBorderlessWithoutPowerfulFoils
definition: Number of borderless cards that lack a Card Kingdom foil listing. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE BorderColor = 'borderless' AND (CardKingdomFoilId IS NULL OR CardKingdomId IS NULL)). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; BorderColor = cards.borderColor; CardKingdomFoilId = cards.cardKingdomFoilId WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL; CardKingdomId = cards.cardKingdomId WHERE cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
aliases: borderless cards available without powerful foils

name: CardLegality
definition: Which formats a card is legal, banned, or restricted in.

name: CardLanguage
definition: Which languages a card or set has been printed or translated in.

name: CardFrameVersion
definition: Which frame style/version a card uses.

name: CardBorderColor
definition: Which border color style a card uses.

name: CardColor
definition: Which color identity a card belongs to.

name: SetType
definition: The category of a card set (core, expansion, promo, etc.).
